body.name: Lfour
body.def: Let \(\mu_+=(1/\sqrt2,2)\), \(\mu_-=(-1/\sqrt2,2)\), and \(\mu_0=(0,2)\). Define \(L_4=\int_{\mathbb R^2}\min_{A\subseteq V_4}[\tfrac12\phi_{\Sigma}(w-\mu_+)\ell(A)+\tfrac12\phi_{\Sigma}(w-\mu_-)\ell(A)+\lambda_4\phi_{\Sigma}(w-\mu_0)\{\mathbf1(02\notin A)+\mathbf1(12\notin A)\}]\,dw-2\eta\lambda_4\).
body.role: exact Lagrange-dual evaluation generated by the displayed atoms
